name: @neuropause/integration-platform
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Production Execution Program, Sprint 3: Universal Enterprise Integration Platform. An additive package (named integration-platform because packages/integrations already exists as a base package) that composes Waves 1-14 and Sprints 1-2, unchanged, into a universal, governed, evidence-first integration layer: a universal integration runtime + connector registry (reusing the base connectors platform), an API gateway (REST/GraphQL/gRPC/SOAP/WebSocket/webhooks/event-streams with real rate limiting + validation + versioning), enterprise identity integration (reusing the Sprint-2 identity platform), and reusable ADAPTER frameworks for ERP, CRM, productivity/collaboration, storage, database, HR, finance, manufacturing, healthcare, messaging, and AI systems, plus a real synchronization engine (incremental/full/conflict/retry/history), a real transformation engine (JSON/XML/CSV/YAML/Parquet mapping + schema registry), integration security (reusing the security platform), monitoring/diagnostics (reusing operations), governance, and documentation. Integration/connector/transformation/synchronization/monitoring runtimes, governance, and documentation are LIVE-VERIFIED; external systems (SAP/Oracle/Dynamics/NetSuite/Salesforce/HubSpot/M365/Google Workspace/Slack/Teams/Stripe/Epic/Oracle Health/Kafka/RabbitMQ/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/…) are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured and verified; customer ERP/CRM/HR/finance/manufacturing/healthcare records are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (never fabricated; no real payments, no live medical records); and customer APIs/credentials/VPNs/message-brokers/databases are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. Evidence is never promoted without configuration and verification. Every integration operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
